subject: Segmentation & network visibility request — Dedicated/Private evidence pack

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-compliance@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Segmentation & network visibility for Dedicated/Private

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Acme's security team is completing a control assessment for our deployment plans and we need a concise evidence set focused on network segmentation and isolation for Redwood's Dedicated and Private deployment options. Specifically we need: 

- High-level network diagrams (sanitized, showing logical zones only) for Dedicated and Private deployments
- A short isolation narrative (1-2 pages) describing tenant boundaries, control plane separation, and egress filtering
- A CAIQ mapping (which CAIQ rows map to Redwood artifacts) and SIG rows export for reviewer consumption
- SOC 2 control matrix entries that relate to network/perimeter controls

Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver the above by end of day Feb 5? If not, a phased delivery is fine — diagrams + narrative first, then CAIQ/SIG mapping. Also let me know if you need a preferred file format or any redaction guidance.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Compliance, Acme Corp
acme-compliance@acme-corp.com

Attachments: request-form-acme-2-2027.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:40:00 -0800

Forwarding Acme's ask — they need diagrams + narrative + CAIQ/SIG + SOC2 mapping by Feb 5 if possible.

Quick asks:
- Kimberly: can you own the CAIQ mapping and SOC2 control matrix? We should reuse the latest SIG export and annotate where we have artifacts.
- Tessa: can you generate sanitized network diagrams (PNG + PDF) and a 1–2 page isolation narrative describing control plane/data plane separation, KV cache isolation, and egress filtering? Include short captions for reviewers.

I'll own the deliverable packaging and the external send. I've attached Acme's request form.

Thanks — Marissa

1) Please confirm receipt and whether you want a short (20–30 min) walkthrough with Kim and Tessa to answer reviewer questions.
2) If reviewers need raw diagram sources or additional audit logs, we can provide via a controlled upload; we'll need an NDA/scoped access confirmation for logs.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on the review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
